set.body:
Owner directive (2026-09-01, single-developer mode): pick up the movie plan at its sanctioned entry point, the first acquisition court (docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md §9.1; docs/design/movie-component-admission-ledger.md §6), not a VLM. The owner authorizes opening the court that the ledger held; the owner-only items (gated model terms, weights approval) are not touched.

Scope of this bead (landing A): F0 project-authored media, FFmpeg ingest, replay.

What lands
- New JVM-only module `media` (ADR 0007 §4 adapter; amendment recorded in the ADR). Depends on core.jvm and circe. The only module allowed to spawn a process.
- F0 v1 fixture: media/src/test/resources/f0/f0-v1.mov (111,250 bytes, sha256 0cf05f22…), generated by media/tools/generate_f0.sh + f0_frames.py. MOV; stream 0 rawvideo rgb24 32x18 at 1/24000, 48 frames minus {5,6,20} dropped with PTS passthrough (VFR, a 3000-tick gap, a 2000-tick hold); stream 1 pcm_s16le mono 8 kHz 440 Hz, 2.000 s. No text, no third-party content. Generator replay verified byte-identical.
- Exact-byte manifest (schema storymodel4s.media.fixture-manifest v1) with the generator's declared ground truth; recorded ffprobe envelope (tool path, version line, binary sha256, exact args, stdout digest) and the verbatim stdout, so ordinary CI replays a recorded receipt instead of executing a tool.
- Types: ToolRealization (name, -version line, binary sha256, identity); FixtureManifest/DeclaredStream/StreamDisposition(Decoded|PacketIndexedOnly|Unsupported); ProbeEnvelope; FfprobeJson parser + Ffprobe canonical invocation; MediaProbe.join (the adapter-side join of manifest, verified input, tool, args, output → Draft CallerRuntimePacketRecords under a SourceDerivationReceipt whose parameters bind the tool identity and args); PacketIndex (explicit packet-to-PTS table; VFR, deltas, contiguity, extent).
- Courts (MediaProbeSuite): bytes vs manifest; declared-vs-observed PTS table; audio tiling; replay identity and tool/args substitution; input mismatch; undeclared/omitted stream; codec/kind/timebase disagreement; PTS<DTS refusal without repair; missing PTS typed and index refusal; duplicate PTS; no promotion of draft records; exact timebase parsing; envelope stdout digest; live ffprobe court when a binary exists (never obtained).

Governance
- Ledger §6 amended from Held to Authorized(this bead, scope): local realization on the owner's machine, Draft authority, F0 and one F1 excerpt, FFmpeg deterministic ingest and PySceneDetect ContentDetector proposals only. The nominated FFmpeg 9.0.1 LGPL-only recipe and the OCI/SBOM closure stay RecipeOnly; a follow-up bead names them.
- ADR 0007 amendment: the `media` adapter module and its vocabulary.

Not in this slice
- No decoding of frames, no PySceneDetect run, no BoundaryClaim or boundary proposal construction, no F1 excerpt (landing B). No PresentationAxis/SourceBundle construction from probes. No E0 promotion path: everything is Draft.
set.title: First acquisition court, landing A: media module, F0 v1 fixture, ffprobe draft probe join
